name: SHOWCASE | Invoice Chase | Schedule → Overdue scan + approval requests | v1

parameters.content:
## SHOWCASE | Invoice Chase | Daily overdue scan | v1 (W2 of 3)
**Purpose:** every morning find overdue invoices, pick a level (friendly 1-7 days, firm 8-30, final 31+), skip any invoice that already has that level, claim the rest in the reminder log, and start ONE approval run (W3) per invoice. Nothing is sent from here. No auto-send path exists.
**Owner:** AI Ops Expert owner. **Trigger:** Schedule, every day 08:00 in the workflow time zone. **Version:** v1. **Last change:** 2026-10-31. **n8n version built on:** PLACEHOLDER_N8N_VERSION_AND_EDITION (unknown). **Built INACTIVE. Synthetic data only.**
**AFTER IMPORT (owner):** (1) Import W3 FIRST, then open "Start approval run (W3)" and select W3 (the file holds PLACEHOLDER_W3_WORKFLOW_ID). (2) Settings > Error Workflow = `SHARED | Error Alert | Error Trigger → Slack alert | v1` (file holds PLACEHOLDER_ERROR_ALERT_WORKFLOW_ID). (3) Timezone: file holds UTC as a safe default; set PLACEHOLDER_TIMEZONE and make the spreadsheet zone equal. (4) Fill the PLACEHOLDER_ values in Settings. (5) Select credentials on each node with a warning; lock header rows of the tabs first. (6) Do not activate. If W2 is ever switched off, pending rows stay and block that invoice's level (the stale sweep only runs here).
**Sheets is not transactional:** claim, then re-read and confirm exactly one row; if it cannot confirm, that invoice is skipped (fails safe) and counted.
**Verify on import:** every typeVersion and each node marked in its notes (design sections 8 and 17).
